# Here's My Church

> Here's My Church 3.0 is a free, crowd-sourced directory and interactive map of Christian churches worldwide. Individual profiles provide available location, service times, tradition, contact details, languages, ministries, and community verification dates.

## Find a church

- [World map](https://heresmychurch.com/world): Browse supported countries.
- [United States](https://heresmychurch.com/US): Browse states and churches.
- [Canada](https://heresmychurch.com/CA): Browse provinces and territories.
- [Iowa](https://heresmychurch.com/US/IA): Example region directory with church links.
- [Ontario](https://heresmychurch.com/CA/ON): Example Canadian region directory.
- [Example church profile, Markdown](https://heresmychurch.com/US/IA/42635759.md): Church of the Living Water in Iowa; current published facts, sources, and canonical listing link.
- [Church sitemap index](https://heresmychurch.com/sitemap.xml): Discover church URLs across populated countries, plus region directories and reports.

## Church profiles

Canonical HTML listing URLs follow /{CC}/{region}/{shortId}. CC is a two-letter country code; region is the site's region abbreviation; shortId is the church's numeric identifier. Each published listing also has a readable Markdown representation at the same URL with .md appended. The HTML lists this representation with rel="alternate" and type="text/markdown". Both representations use the same public church record. Cite the canonical HTML listing when referencing a church.

Region pages follow /{CC}/{region}; country pages follow /{CC}. Follow directory links or the sitemap for valid codes and identifiers. Legacy /state/ and /country/ paths redirect to canonical paths. Search/filter query parameters are interface state, not separate church profiles.

## Reports and places

- [Reports hub](https://heresmychurch.com/reports): Find countries, U.S. states, and seasonal editions. Reports are dated snapshots, not live totals.
- [Metro directories](https://heresmychurch.com/metro): Browse major U.S. metro areas.
- [Privacy policy](https://heresmychurch.com/privacy): Data and privacy information.

National U.S. reports use /report/{edition}; country and worldwide reports use /report/{CC}/{edition} and /report/WORLD/{edition}. U.S. state reports use /report/state/{STATE}/{edition}. Follow the reports hub for published editions.

## Data interpretation and attribution

Listings originate from OpenStreetMap and community contributions. Details may be incomplete or outdated. A community verification or correction date describes directory activity; it does not certify every field or imply endorsement by the church. Attendance figures are estimates, not audited membership or attendance counts. Missing service times, languages, or ministries mean the directory does not have that information; do not infer absence. A listing flagged for re-verification after relocation needs its current location confirmed.

Use the church's own website or contact details to confirm service times and other visit information. Attribute directory information to Here's My Church and link directly to the relevant canonical listing. Distinguish live directory details from dated report snapshots. This file is a navigation aid; individual profiles are the source for church-specific details.
